Lessons: Genesis: Beginnings and Promise; Exodus and the Law; Conquest and Judges; United and Divided Kingdoms; Poetry and Wisdom; Major Prophets; Minor Prophets; Exile, Return and Waiting
Description: Go deeper into the first three-quarters of your Bible with confidence. This survey traces God's covenant story through creation, exodus, kingdom, exile and return, helping you read the Law, the Prophets and the Writings as one unfolding promise. You will finish with a map you can trust.
